mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_result (run_id, case_id, question, retrieved_ctx, answer, recall_score, faithfulness, status, error_msg) VALUES (#{runId}, #{caseId}, #{question}, #{retrievedCtx}, #{answer}, #{recallScore}, #{faithfulness}, #{status}, #{errorMsg})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, case_id, question, retrieved_ctx, answer, recall_score, faithfulness, status, error_msg, created_at FROM ai_eval_result WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id
SELECT run_id FROM ai_eval_result ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT run_id, AVG(recall_score) AS avg_recall, AVG(faithfulness) AS avg_faithfulness, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed, MAX(created_at) AS created_at FROM ai_eval_result GROUP BY run_id ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
